sections.title: Parent Relationship & Family History
sections.description: Core details about the parent-child relationship and the parent beneficiary's family history.

questions.label: What is the parent beneficiary's relationship to the petitioner?
questions.helpText: Select the legal parent-child relationship used for the IR-5 petition

questions.label: What is the parent beneficiary's marital history?
questions.helpText: Select the option that best describes the parent's current and prior marital history

questions.label: Does the parent beneficiary have children other than the petitioner?
questions.helpText: Include biological, adopted, and other legally recognized children

sections.title: Parent-Child Relationship & Contact
sections.description: How the parent beneficiary and petitioner have lived together and remained in contact.

questions.label: Has the parent beneficiary lived with the petitioner?
questions.helpText: Select the option that best describes their living history

questions.label: How often do the parent beneficiary and petitioner communicate?
When did the parent beneficiary last see the petitioner in person?

sections.title: Sponsorship, Employment & Settlement
sections.description: The financial sponsorship structure, current employment status, and planned living arrangement in the United States.

questions.label: Which financial sponsorship structure is being used?
questions.helpText: Select the structure used in the Affidavit of Support package

questions.label: Where does the parent beneficiary plan to live after arriving in the United States?
questions.helpText: Select the planned initial living arrangement

questions.label: What is the parent beneficiary's current employment status?
questions.helpText: Select the parent's current employment or retirement status

sections.title: Civil Records & Foreign Residence
sections.description: Identify civil-document issues and foreign residence history that may lead to additional interview questions.

questions.label: Are there any known issues with the parent-child civil records?
questions.helpText: Consider the petitioner's birth certificate, the parent's birth record, names, dates, and issuing authorities

questions.label: Has the parent beneficiary ever lived outside Pakistan?
questions.helpText: Include residence outside Pakistan for employment, study, family reasons, or another long-term stay

sections.title: Immigration & Background
sections.description: Prior U.S. immigration, criminal, military, police, and security history relevant to interview preparation.

questions.label: Which option best describes the parent beneficiary's prior U.S. immigration history?
questions.helpText: Select the most relevant option; choose the combined option if more than one applies
options: No Prior U.S. Visa Application or Travel
Prior U.S. Visa Application but No Travel or Violation
Previously Visited the U.S. Without an Immigration Issue
Previous U.S. Visa Refusal or Withdrawn Application
Previous U.S. Immigration Petition or Immigrant Visa Application
Previous Overstay, Status Violation, Entry Denial, Removal, or Deportation

questions.label: Has the parent beneficiary ever been arrested, charged, or convicted of a crime?
questions.helpText: Answer yes even if the case was dismissed, expunged, or occurred many years ago

questions.label: Has the parent beneficiary ever served or worked in the military, police, paramilitary, government security, intelligence, or another armed organization?
questions.helpText: Include mandatory, voluntary, reserve, police, paramilitary, intelligence, and other armed or security service
